name: carousel
title: Carousel
purpose: Browse a typed collection through an accessible, draggable, snapping viewport with configurable presentation and navigation placement.
avoidFor: Critical content available only through autoplay
accessibility: The root is a labelled region and each item is a named slide group.
Previous, next, and indicator actions use native buttons independently of pointer dragging.
Autoplay pauses for pointer, focus, dragging, and document visibility.
sizes: typed slides per view and pixel gap
commonMistakes: Showing too many slides for the available width.

examples.title: Card collection
examples.description: Two visible slides keep adjacent content discoverable.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Carousel from "@/components/ui/Carousel.vue";
const items = [
  { id: "slide-1", label: "Card placeholder 1" },
  { id: "slide-2", label: "Card placeholder 2" },
  { id: "slide-3", label: "Card placeholder 3" },
  { id: "slide-4", label: "Card placeholder 4" },
  { id: "slide-5", label: "Card placeholder 5" },
];
</script>

<template>
  <Carousel :items="items" label="Cards placeholder" orientation="horizontal" align="start" :slides-per-view="2" :gap="16" :autoplay="0">
    <template #item="{ item }"><article class="p-balsa-2xl">{{ item.label }}</article></template>
  </Carousel>
</template>
